items.name: Product Hunt Visual Launch Editor
items.tagline: See your launch as you build it
items.description: See your Product Hunt launch come to life as you build it! The new visual editor lets you edit your launch in fewer steps while while automatically saving your draft. You can simply click the name, tagline, gallery or makers to edit them in place. A checklist shows what's required and what will help your launch stand out, and clicking a checklist item will take you straight to the field that needs work. Drafts, scheduled launches and live launches now all use the same editor.

items.name: MOVO AI
items.tagline: The world's first long-form video agent for mobile
items.description: MOVO AI is the world’s first AI video agent for long-form creation that works right from your phone. It also works on the web. Shoot, upload, or start with an idea, then tell MOVO AI what you want. MOVO plans, creates, refines, keeps characters and scenes consistent, and brings the whole video together. Lock your phone and MOVO keeps working. Come back to review or make changes through chat. No prompt gymnastics. No canvas-heavy workflows. No manual clip stitching.

items.name: Agent Hunt
items.tagline: Live rankings of the tools AI agents use most
items.description: Agent Hunt is a live leaderboard of the tools AI agents actually use. Every place is earned by real calls agents make through Monid.

items.name: Ovren Live Preview
items.tagline: See your product change live before it ships
items.description: Describe a change in plain words. Ovren writes the code on a safe copy of your project and gives you a live preview of every frontend change — your real page, with the change on it. Click through it, approve it, and your team merges the pull request.

items.name: ElevenLabs Realtime
items.tagline: Realtime voice agent models with 570ms to first audio
items.description: Eleven Realtime is ElevenLabs’ new family of speech-to-speech models for voice agents. Speech recognition, turn-taking, the LLM and the voice are tuned end-to-end. v1 Mini is built for natural conversation, v1 Max for complex tasks, with 620ms and 570ms to first audio. It supports 90+ languages and works in ElevenAgents or through an OpenAI-compatible Realtime API, so you only change the endpoint and model name.

items.name: ShogunAI
items.tagline: Your personal AGI on your pc
items.description: An AI assistant that remembers your work and helps with meeting prep, search, writing and follow-ups. Try ShogunAI for Mac free for 7 days.

items.name: FLUX 3 Max
items.tagline: fal’s FLUX 3 Max: 10-second AI video in about 12 seconds
items.description: FLUX 3 Max is fal’s post-trained text-to-video and image-to-video model, built with Black Forest Labs on the FLUX 3 base. fal says it generates a 10-second 720p clip in about 12 seconds, around 10x faster than FLUX 3. It is tied for #1 on a preliminary Artificial Analysis image-to-video board. Pricing is $0.0425 per second of video through November 7 (list $0.17), with a playground and API.

items.name: Cloudflare Clairic
items.tagline: Cloudflare's AI model for fast, cheap data extraction
items.description: Clairic is Cloudflare's new AI model for extracting structured information without generating tokens. Give it messy text or images, and it returns typed values like names, dates, amounts, calculations, and estimates in a single pass, with confidence scores. Built for developers who need faster, cheaper data processing than traditional LLM calls. Available in preview on Workers AI at $0.10 per million input tokens, with open weights planned.

items.name: Context Engine
items.tagline: One memory for your AI agents and human team members.
items.description: Context Engine is one memory for your AI agents and your team. Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Claude Code save to it as they work, and the people on your team read it, ask it questions and add files. Free to start.

items.name: Dub Startup Program
items.tagline: Launch your partner-led growth program
items.description: Launch your partner program, track every referral, and reward the people helping you grow. Get 50% off your first year of Dub.

items.name: Polylane for Cloudflare
items.tagline: An AI on-call engineer for your Cloudflare apps
items.description: Polylane catches issues across your Cloudflare apps, follows the connections between Workers, databases, queues and storage, and investigates the root cause using your code, logs and recent changes. When the fix is in your code, it opens a pull request for review. Connect with one read-only Cloudflare token.

items.name: Instant Search
items.tagline: The fastest, most precise local AI Search for your files.
items.description: Instant is the first accurate local AI file search that uses the latest embedding models to find the exact file (and page) with the content you’re looking for with a 95% hit rate.

items.name: Monish
items.tagline: Your AI agents, live on your iPhone lock screen
items.description: Paste one line into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, n8n or any script. Your agent can then put live progress on your lock screen, ping you when it's done, and ask before it deploys, sends or spends: Approve or Deny from the notification. Free, no account.

items.name: Inyon
items.tagline: Answer your coding agents from your phone
items.description: Inyon shows the coding agents already running in tmux on your machines (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Copilot CLI, Antigravity) as chats on your phone or in a browser. When one asks something, you answer with a tap and it's typed into the same pane, so nothing changes when you sit back down. No account and nothing to host: pair the Android app by QR code and it reaches your computers over an end-to-end encrypted tunnel or your VPN. Free, open source, MIT.

items.name: Plango
items.tagline: Use AI to defend against AI
items.description: Secure your Mac while building with AI. Plango monitors AI coding agents, protects sensitive files and secrets, blocks suspicious network activity, scans projects for vulnerabilities, and gives you control over what your agents can access. Powered by an on-device AI security model. Private by default.

items.name: Headroom
items.tagline: Your Mac on iPhone Duo: fold it, and the keyboard appears
items.description: Control your Mac from iPhone, iPad or another Mac. Headroom is a Screen Sharing client: remote access with nothing to install on the Mac, no account, no server in between. On iPhone Duo it changes with every pose: half open, Mac on top, keyboard below.

items.name: Dots
items.tagline: A customizable workspace built into your Mac's notch
items.description: Meet Dots, a customizable workspace built into your Mac's notch. Most notch apps focus on music and notifications. Dots goes further by helping you access your favorite apps, websites, and shortcuts without constantly switching windows. Watch videos while working, take scrolling screenshots, use voice commands, and more. Whether you're studying, coding, or creating, Dots adapts to your workflow. Free to get started. No subscriptions.

items.name: Peras
items.tagline: Pause Claude Code and Codex before they burn your week
items.description: Peras puts a line in your Claude Code and Codex week. Set it (peras set weekly 85 pause) and once usage crosses it, the agent's next tool call is refused with a plain reason, so one long task can't burn the rest of your week. Resume whenever you want, from the terminal or the menu bar. Opt-in: your agents can be told their own usage. The CLI and hooks are free and MIT. The native Mac menu bar app is €4.99 once.

items.name: Truffle
items.tagline: Fix messy tags, covers and duplicates in your Mac library
items.description: Truffle recognizes each track by its sound and checks eight sources to fix titles, artists, albums, genres, covers, tempo and key. Works with Apple Music, local folders, rekordbox, Serato and Traktor. Nothing is written until you confirm.

items.name: Termi Protocol
items.tagline: Watch AI agents code in 3D and hand off the work
items.description: Termi is a 3D room where your real coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode and more) work at their own desks. You watch every file read, command and edit live, not a scrolling log. New since our first launch: when an agent hits a usage, rate or context limit, Termi saves its goal, changed files, errors and todos, then hands the work to an agent on another model. A boss agent splits one goal across your team. Deleted agents go to a trash. Now on macOS, Windows and Linux.
